months.focus: Foundations: work confidently on the Linux command line
months.deliverable: Set up a small Linux VM or container, create two users and a shared directory with the right permissions, then write a one-page runbook of the commands you used and why.

months.focus: Foundations: automate routine tasks with Bash
topics: text processing with grep, sed and awk
months.deliverable: Write a backup script that archives a folder, keeps the last five copies, logs what it did and exits with a non-zero code on failure.

months.focus: Foundations: use Python to script operations work
months.deliverable: Build a Python tool that reads a log file, counts errors per hour and writes a JSON summary, with tests for the parsing function.
Contribute to a small repository through a feature branch and a pull request, resolve a deliberate merge conflict, and write a short note on your branching rules.

months.focus: Build and ship: understand how traffic reaches your service
months.deliverable: Trace a request to a website with dig, curl -v and a packet capture, then draw each hop and write one sentence on what could fail at each.

months.focus: Build and ship: build a pipeline that tests and ships code
months.deliverable: Create a CI pipeline for a small app with lint, test and package stages that runs on every pull request, and promote the same tested artifact to a second environment.

months.focus: Build and ship: package applications as containers
months.deliverable: Containerise a two-service app (web plus database) with Docker Compose, keep the data in a volume, and cut the image size with a multi-stage build.

months.focus: Build and ship: run workloads on a cloud platform
months.deliverable: Deploy your container to a cloud VM or managed service inside a private network using a role with least privilege, and write down its monthly cost estimate.

months.focus: Orchestrate and automate: run containers reliably at scale
months.deliverable: Deploy your app to a local Kubernetes cluster with three replicas, expose it through an ingress, add readiness and liveness probes, and demonstrate a rolling update and a rollback.

months.focus: Orchestrate and automate: describe infrastructure as code
months.deliverable: Write Terraform that creates a network and a server, store its state remotely, turn it into a reusable module, and show what a plan reports after a manual change.

months.focus: Orchestrate and automate: configure servers repeatably
months.deliverable: Write an Ansible playbook that configures a web server from a bare VM, run it twice to show that nothing changes the second time, and keep its secrets in a vault.

months.focus: Orchestrate and automate: release with confidence
months.deliverable: Set up a GitOps tool that syncs a repository to your cluster, ship a canary release, break it on purpose and roll it back through Git.

months.focus: Operate and get hired: see what your system is doing
months.deliverable: Instrument a service with metrics and logs, build a dashboard for request rate, errors and latency, and define one SLO with an alert on its error budget.

months.focus: Operate and get hired: build security into the pipeline
months.deliverable: Add dependency and image scanning to your pipeline, fix the highest-severity finding, and move one hard-coded secret into the secret store.

months.focus: Operate and get hired: put the whole path together
topics: a pipeline from commit to production
months.deliverable: Deliver an end-to-end project: an app with a CI/CD pipeline, containers on Kubernetes, infrastructure in Terraform, monitoring with an alert, and a README that lets a stranger reproduce it.

months.focus: Operate and get hired: prepare to be hired
months.deliverable: Record a five-minute walkthrough of your capstone, write answers to ten scenario questions (for example a deploy that fails at 2 a.m.), and complete two mock interviews.
